Summary of a fit pooled over imputations

Source: R/summary.mvgam.R
summary.mvgam_pooled.Rd

The summary of a fit from mvgam_multiple(). The estimates come from the pooled draws. Chains from different imputations sample different posteriors, which raises the R-hat of the pooled chains. Each parameter's Rhat is its largest over the imputation fits instead. Bulk_ESS and Tail_ESS are the sums over those fits. A table gives each fit's largest R-hat and smallest ESS over its parameters.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_pooled'
summary(object, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), robust = FALSE, matrices = FALSE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_pooled_summary'
print(x, digits = 2, ...)

Arguments

object

A fit of class mvgam_pooled.

probs

Numeric vector of probabilities for quantile computation. Default is c(0.025, 0.975) for 95% credible intervals. Can be a single value or multiple values.

robust

Logical. If FALSE (the default), uses mean and standard deviation for summaries. If TRUE, uses median and median absolute deviation (MAD).

matrices

Logical; if TRUE, also print every cell of the matrices a correlated, VAR or hierarchical trend derives from its sampled parameters (Phi_trend, Sigma_trend, Omega_trend, Phi_group_trend, Sigma_group_trend). The default FALSE prints the sampled parameters alone, among them sigma_trend, Amu_trend, Aomega_trend and alpha_cor_trend. posterior_transition_matrix() and residual_cor() summarise the matrices a cell at a time.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

x

An object of class mvgam_pooled_summary.

digits

Integer number of decimal places to print.

Value

summary() returns an object of class c("mvgam_pooled_summary", "mvgam_summary"). It holds the blocks of summary.mvgam() and mi_diagnostics, a list of the number of imputations, the draws per imputation and the per-imputation convergence table. print() returns x invisibly.

See also

mvgam_multiple(), summary.mvgam()
